verdict.summary: Round 3 remains clean. The incremental branch refreshes the live concept-index count after delta extraction and before constructing the returned report and hierarchy. The fresh-restriction test exercises the real incremental path, proves the index grows, and checks that IncrementalReport and ClassHierarchy expose the same refreshed count. The broader edit-by-edit differentials still compare entailment-bearing hierarchy and report fields against full reclassification, including randomized addition, retraction, and triple-at-a-time streams. The conservative fallback boundaries for retractions, existing-node mutations, RBox vocabulary, and concrete-domain graphs remain consistent with the E5 design record. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or hostile-instruction issue is evident. With zero findings in both rounds 2 and 3, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
